Skills.Name: Normal Attack: Flames Weave Life
Skills.Desc:
<color=#FFD780FF>Normal Attack</color>
Performs up to 4 consecutive claymore strikes.

<color=#FFD780FF>Charged Attack</color>
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to perform an especially powerful Severing Splendor strike toward the front.

<color=#FFD780FF>Plunging Attack</color>
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

Skills.Name: The Named Moment
Skills.Desc: Calling upon her authority over "conflict," Mavuika summons the All-Fire Armaments passed down through the line of human Archons, dealing Nightsoul-aligned Pyro DMG After using this, Mavuika's Nightsoul points are restored to max value, and she enters the Nightsoul's Blessing state. All-Fire Armaments Has different forms when Tapped or Held. Tap "Divine Name Unleashed": The All-Fire Armaments manifest as Rings of Searing Radiance. The Rings follow the current active character and attack nearby opponents at intervals, dealing Nightsoul-aligned Pyro DMG. Hold "Ancient Name Unbound": The All-Fire Armaments manifest as a Flamestrider. In this state, Mavuika can ride the Flamestrider at high speed, or activate its hidden backup propulsion module to temporarily cross various terrain types and glide in mid-air. Mavuika's Normal, Charged, and Plunging Attacks will also be converted to deal Nightsoul-aligned Pyro DMG which cannot be overridden. When sprinting, she also deals Nightsoul-aligned Pyro DMG to opponents along her path. While in the Nightsoul's Blessing state, Tapping the Elemental Skill can switch the All-Fire Armaments' form. The Armaments will disappear once Mavuika's Nightsoul's Blessing state ends. Nightsoul's Blessing: Mavuika Continuously consumes Nightsoul points according to the All-Fire Armaments' form. Mavuika's Nightsoul's Blessing state ends once her Nightsoul points are exhausted. If you told Mavuika that in another world vehicles like the Flamestrider required license plates for identification, that would make her happy too: "Well, mine's the only one that exists here. Guess that means I get to pick whatever plate number I want, huh?"

Skills.Name: Hour of Burning Skies
Skills.Desc: Let the people's inner voices reach the divine throne in the heavens. Mavuika's Elemental Burst is not reliant on Energy, but instead, on "Fighting Spirit." Fighting Spirit When Mavuika has at least 50% Fighting Spirit, she can consume it all to unleash her Elemental Burst. Mavuika can obtain Fighting Spirit via the following methods: · When in combat, Nightsoul points consumed by nearby party members are converted to Fighting Spirit. · When nearby party members' Normal Attacks hit opponents, Mavuika gains 1.5 Fighting Spirit. This can trigger once every 0.1s. After using this, Mavuika gains 10 Nightsoul points and enters the Nightsoul's Blessing state. Riding her Flamestrider high in the air, she uses a powerful Sunfell Slice against opponents on the ground, dealing Nightsoul-aligned AoE Pyro DMG and entering the "Crucible of Death and Life" state. Crucible of Death and Life During this time, Mavuika's various actions will no longer consume Nightsoul points, and her interruption resistance is increased. Also, the DMG dealt by Sunfell Slice and "Ancient Name Unbound"'s Normal and Charged Attacks is increased based on the amount of Fighting Spirit she has when using the Elemental Burst. Crucible of Death and Life will be canceled when Mavuika leaves the field. "—But this time, I shall shatter this destiny with my own hands."

Passives.Name: Gift of Flaming Flowers
Passives.Desc: When a nearby party member triggers a Nightsoul Burst, Mavuika's ATK increases by 35% for 10s.

Passives.Name: "Kiongozi"
Passives.Desc: After using her Elemental Burst, <color=#FFD780FF>Hour of Burning Skies</color>, every point of Fighting Spirit present when it is used increases the DMG that the current active character deals by 0.25%. The maximum increase obtainable this way is 50%, and this effect lasts 20s, decaying over this duration until it reaches 0.

Passives.Name: Night Realm's Gift: Exhaust Mode
Passives.Desc: After Nightsoul points have been fully depleted, Mavuika will switch to using Phlogiston to maintain the All-Fire Armaments' Flamestrider form.\nWhile in an area with Phlogiston Mechanics within Natlan, Nightsoul Transmission: Mavuika can be used. When the current active character is sprinting, climbing, swimming, in movement modes caused by certain Talents, or at a certain height in the air, switching to Mavuika will trigger the following: Mavuika enters the Nightsoul's Blessing state and obtains 50% of her maximum Nightsoul points. Nightsoul Transmission can be triggered once every 10s by your own party.

Passives.Name: Life Talent
Passives.Desc: The party's Nightsoul Transmission CD is decreased by 20%.

Constellations.Name: The Night-Lord's Explication
Constellations.Desc: Mavuika's maximum Nightsoul points are increased to 120, and she gains Fighting Spirit 25% more efficiently.\nAdditionally, she gains 40% ATK for 8s after gaining Fighting Spirit.

Constellations.Name: The Ashen Price
Constellations.Desc: When in the Nightsoul's Blessing State, Mavuika's Base ATK is increased by 300, and she obtains the following effects based on All-Fire Armaments' form:\n· Rings of Searing Radiance: Nearby opponents' DEF decreased by 20%.\n· Flamestrider: Each point of Mavuika's ATK increases her Normal Attack DMG by 1, and her Charged Attack DMG by 1.5.

Constellations.Name: The Burning Sun
Constellations.Desc: Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Hour of Burning Skies</color> by 3.\nMaximum upgrade level is 15.

Constellations.Name: The Leader's Resolve
Constellations.Desc: Enhances the effects of the Passive Talent "Kiongozi":\nThe DMG increase gained after using the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>Hour of Burning Skies</color> will not decay over time.\nYou must first unlock the Passive Talent "Kiongozi."

Constellations.Name: The Meaning of Truth
Constellations.Desc: Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>The Named Moment</color> by 3.\nMaximum upgrade level is 15.

Constellations.Name: "Humanity's Name" Unfettered
Constellations.Desc:
The All-Fire Armaments from the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>The Named Moment</color> receive all-around improvements:
· Rings of Searing Radiance: When the Rings' attacks hit opponents, a Flamestrider will crash into the struck opponent, dealing 200% of ATK as Nightsoul-aligned <color=#FF9999FF>AoE Pyro DMG</color>.
· Flamestrider: When Mavuika is riding the Flamestrider, Rings of Searing Radiance will also follow her, dealing 400% of ATK as Nightsoul-aligned <color=#FF9999FF>AoE Pyro DMG</color> to nearby opponents once every 3s. Mavuika's terrain-crossing abilities will also be further improved.

Additionally, when Mavuika is riding her Flamestrider and is not in combat, when her Nightsoul points drop to 5, she will gain 80 points. This effect can trigger once every 15s.
